# Testing Instructions

## Core Rules
- Reuse existing test frameworks and repository test patterns.
- Add or update tests for changed behavior when test infrastructure exists.
- Run targeted tests first, then broader test suites as needed.
- Do not remove unrelated tests.

## Validation Requirements
- Confirm both happy-path and key edge cases for modified behavior.
- Report exactly what was executed and results.
- Do not claim completion without validation evidence.

## If No Test Infrastructure Exists
- Document manual verification steps and outcomes.
- Recommend minimal next-step test additions when appropriate.
